newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian stocks inch up but volume sharply off.
newsitem.headline: Estonian stocks inch up but volume sharply off.

text.p: The index crept up on Estonia's bourse on Thursday but volume dropped sharply, the Tallinn Stock Exchange said in a statement.
Overall market volume was 3.8 million kroons versus 11.9 million kroons on Wednesday, and the index advanced by 0.04 percent to 97.94.
Forex Bank was the most active listing at almost 1.4 million kroons, closing fractionally down at 77.15 kroons compared with 77.40 kroons on Wednesday.
Tallinn Bank was also active at just over one million kroons, but it moved ahead to 39.75 kroons, up from 37.70.
Despite Thursday's lack of volume, dealers said overseas interest in the new Estonian bourse remained high and predicted steady gains throughout the autumn.
Estonia's economy is regarded by many as the most liberal and dynamic of former Soviet Union states.
